tests.name: drains a full window after delayed duplicate ACKs and verifies every byte
tests.scope: Hold all 96 emitted blocks before any receive; deliver/commit64 and withhold ACK; assert zero sender progress/no completion; deliver duplicate ACK then remaining data/ACKs; check one completion, exact indices/no retransmission, bounded queue and independent full file byte audit.

tests.name: reconnects after a batched durable ACK is lost without resending that batch
tests.scope: Hold96; persist64 with ACK withheld, close channel, no sender success; close/reopen shared memory repository, recover range[0,64), resume exactly missing indices64..132, independent exact tree/path/size/file bytes audit.

distinction: Existing percent-resume tests already lose a single final ACK. These two schedules add controlled 96-block window pressure and 64-block batched durability/ACK delay, not a newly discovered production defect.

negativeControls.name: resume-mutant
negativeControls.change: Isolated test copy ignores recovered resume ranges; no production or committed test mutation.
negativeControls.observedFailure: Exact missing-index assertion fails, before transfer can hang.

negativeControls.name: pattern-mutant
negativeControls.change: Isolated test copy changes first source byte before preparation; source and stream hashes remain self-consistent.
negativeControls.observedFailure: Independent pattern audit rejects byte0 after production hash verification.

validation.dependencies: Existing fresh dependency stage and unchanged lock; no new npm ci.
validation.browserScope: Previous88Edge/88Chrome gates retained: all application/server/runtime/build inputs unchanged; no full browser rerun for test-only addition. Prior native CMD coverage composition caveats retained.

review.correctness: Receipts counted only after durable batch, duplicated ACK does not inflate counts, close cannot report success, resume excludes durable data; hash verify plus independent byte/path checks. Negative controls fail at intended assertions.
review.readability: One small local controlled channel and two explicit schedules; no reusable transport framework or production interface added.
review.architecture: Production sender/receiver/queue/codec used directly; test-only wire and repository do not claim browser/process durability.
review.security: No network, secrets, permissions or production-policy change.
review.performance: Two bounded ~8MiB fixture tests; 2500ms failure deadline only, explicit delivery gates determine ordering. No throughput measurement.

limitations: Logical ACK API calls bypass application authorization/control dispatch; duplicate other control types are not covered here.
In-memory reopen proves model receipt reuse, not OPFS durability under OS/process/browser crash.
No deterministic coverage claim for every chaos requirement. Native reconnect/permissions/quota/runtime restart/physical acceptance remain separate.
Initial focused log predates the added early no-resend assertion. focused-final/type/unit/build are the final test revision.
Mutant failures are intentional fixture negative controls, not discovered production bugs or failed release gates.
